minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, August 21st, 2024

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at: 10:00 AM on Wednesday, August, 21st, 2024.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Jenny Jolly, Scott Snider, Terry
  Kistler, George Borst.

  Members Absent: None

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Director, Armando
  Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Community
  Services Specialist.

  It was moved by Scott Snider and seconded by Edward Padgett to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, June 19th, 2024 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: April Williams, Regional Coordinator Lead, YWCA.

  April explained the various programs available to seniors. YWCA covers 22 cities
  in the San Gabriel Valley and serves 60 seniors in our La Verne Community Center
  with the Senior Nutrition Program. Many events are sponsored by the YWCA such
  as Mini Markets and Trunk or Treats. They will begin introducing an Adopt a
  Senior Campaign. For more information, please contact (626) 690-2995.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 22 participants per week
  in June and meals were served to average of 22 participants per week in July.

  Meals on Wheels: Update.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account through August 21st, 2024 was
  $16.50. Deposit of $210.00. Liabilities to Bingo West was $276.00. The
  average attendance for July was 48 players per week. Attendance up from
  previous two months.

5. Account Balance: $2,452.05.
 6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid for May. Bingo Paid $776.00 in fees
  owed from previous months. Will pay $100 over the normal fees in the next couple
  of months till previous months fees are paid off.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Registration for Winter/Spring classes will be on 11/22/24 from
  11:30AM-1:30PM. Mt. Sac Classes will be offering fee-based classes in the next
  weeks.

8. Aging Next: 7 La Verne residents were served in June and 6 in July.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Aquatic Center is open. Will begin construction on
  playground at Las Flores near elementary school. Maybe adding pickleball
  courts to Live Oak park.

10. Upcoming Events:

  •  Friday, August 23rd– Senior Seminar: Presented by Eldercare Now, My Calling Inc., 9:30 AM.
  •  Thursday, August 29th– Country Western Line Dancing Party, Sponsored by Visiting Angels, 10:00AM-
  12:00PM.
  •  Friday, August 30th– Senior Seminar, Pilot Program with Uber, Presented by Pomona Valley
  Transportation Authority, 9:30AM.
  •  Wednesday, September 4th– Senior Seminar, Medicare 101, Presented by The Informed Group,
  9:30AM.
  •  Sunday, September 8th– Excursion, Big Bear Lake Octoberfest, 9:30AM-6:00PM.
  •  Monday, September 9th– Movie Matinee, Wild Hogs, 12:30PM.
  •  Tuesday, September 10th– Senior Craft Fair, 9:00AM-12:00PM.
  •  Tuesday, September 24th– Health and Resource Fair and Flu and Covid Shot Clinic, 9:00AM-11:30AM.

  Public Comments: Mayor Tim Hepburn sat in on the meeting and will contact
  Meals on Wheels for the senior group. Bette Donvan stated that the September
  Craft Fair attendance may determine future craft fairs. Please stop by on 9/10
  from 9:00AM-12:00PM. George Borst inquired about the lack of parking on
  Wednesdays due to non-visitors parking in the parking lot. This is actively
  being addressed by the City and the La Verne Police Department for acceptable
  solutions. Scott Snider announced that the Arts and Crafts Fair at Hillcrest will
  be held on Sunday 9/14 from 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM. Lorraine Missick asked to
  have a table at the health fair for the Pomona Valley Medical Center to promote
  the desperate need for volunteers.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:54AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, September 18th, 2024 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Community Services Specialist
